events.what: Two vessels struck during attempted transit; container ship GFS Pride sank; Hormuz transits fell to 12 from 27
US Treasury sanctions Iranian oil sales intermediary Razavi, two Iran-based firms, banks and exchange houses
CENTCOM says it destroyed 10 Iran-linked tankers and turned around 135 ships in three months of blockade enforcement
IEA Governing Board accelerates emergency stock releases, about 100 million barrels remaining, incl. over 20 million barrels diesel
US Energy Secretary Wright floats possible easing of sanctions on Russian, Venezuelan and Iranian shadow-fleet tankers to lower freight
Hurricane Isaias: producers shut in/evacuated from Oct. 6; over 90% restarted by Oct. 14; Category 3 storm prompted refinery precautionary shutdowns
Drone attack and fire at 342,000 b/d Ryazan refinery; Zelenskyy says pause on attacking refineries is out
US announces deal to buy Russian diesel with Treasury sanctions waiver; Russia partially lifts diesel export ban Oct. 10
Gulf producers accelerate Hormuz-bypass pipelines; Qatar rejects pipelines
Union blockade of access to Eni 122,000 b/d Taranto refinery since Oct. 12; units may have to shut
Houthi blockade on Saudi shipping referenced; Somali piracy surge; EU naval force cites Yemen conflict
G7 leaders set four-month deadline for releasing outstanding 100 million barrels of stocks
